about: What the repository cannot say about itself in a manifest: one plain line per file a plugin writes and per script it ships. Every entry carries a proof, a string the generator must find in that plugin's own files. When the proof is gone the build fails, so this page cannot quietly go stale.

sidequest.what: The board's id prefix, routing table, categories, settings and id counters.
One ticket per file: flat frontmatter, then What, Done when and Log.
One story per file: the destination, the decisions and what is out of scope. Also the analysis of a plan, and the hand-over when the plan has a step before building.
The brief the start tool last printed for that ticket, kept so the reviewer and a wave of agents can read it.

A line for `.sidequest/`, added by the write that first creates the board, so the board stays out of git. Not added when git already tracks or ignores the folder. A line for `.claude/worktrees/`, added by the first start that puts an agent in a worktree, so those folders stay out of `git status`. Not added when this file or the root `.gitignore` already lists it.

quartermaster.what: Evidence: one line per sensed event, append-only, one file per session per day. Written in every session while Quartermaster is installed.
quartermaster.shared: Personal. Lives in your home folder.

quartermaster.what: Each time an offer was shown, so an ignored offer backs off.
quartermaster.shared: Personal. Lives in your home folder.

quartermaster.what: One proposal per file: kind, target, evidence, the check with today's baseline, the exact change and the rollback.
quartermaster.shared: Personal by default. Delete the folder's `.gitignore` to share it.

quartermaster.what: The record of an applied change. `prior/` beside it holds the bytes of every file as it was before.
What you said no to, with your reason. Never proposed again.
What you kept on purpose during an upgrade, one line each with the date and your reason.
Keeps the whole records folder out of git, because it also holds saved copies of your local settings.
quartermaster.shared: Delete it to commit the records.

codebase-mapper.what: The index: what the system is, the areas, the key flows. Always loaded. Stays under 40 lines.
One card per area, with `paths` globs and a `verified-at` commit.
Guidance a person wrote in an older map, such as a style guide or a how-to, kept in its own words with `paths` frontmatter. Written only when an older map held some. Refresh never touches it.

live-rules.what: A rule, with `paths` frontmatter when it applies to part of the project only.
A project skill, for an instruction that a word in the request should trigger.
The same two files for all your projects. Written only when you ask for user scope or say "everywhere".
live-rules.shared: Personal. Lives in your home folder.

observability.what: One line per finished turn, one file per session: the session's first prompt line, a ticket id, models, tokens, the engine's cost, timings, tool and agent counts. Only in a project switched on with `/track on`.
observability.shared: Personal. Lives in your config folder and never leaves the machine.

observability.what: The usage page, a self-contained page written when you run `/usage-page`. The file keeps the older version's name.
observability.shared: Personal. Lives in your config folder.

sidequest.what: Lists the boards on this machine with counts and last change. Removes one only with `--remove=<project folder>`.
Gives every linked worktree a verdict, safe or keep. `--remove-safe` removes the safe ones.

quartermaster.what: Install-day hindsight: counts from the transcripts you already have. Prints one JSON object, never prompts or file contents.
The facts behind `inspect`: this project's plugin rows, and cancelled hooks in the newest transcript.
Finds Toolshed plugins installed by hand with no change record. `--record` writes the records.
Read-only scan of what is left of the older version in a project, with a verdict per leftover.
Records what you kept on purpose during an upgrade.
Lists projects with the older version on and no session or commit in 30 days. `--switch-off` switches it off there after your yes.
Converts the older rules (`.claude/live-rules/` or the single `.claude/live-rules.md` page) into `.claude/rules/` and project skills. Prints the plan; `--write` applies it.
The home folder cleanup after the last project moved, one group at a time.

codebase-mapper.what: Says which map cards are stale. `--line` prints one line, the default is JSON.

live-rules.what: Audits `.claude/rules/`: dead globs, oversized or duplicate rules, leftover old keys.

observability.what: Reads a project's usage ledger and prints cost and tokens by day, model, category, ticket or routing, or the costliest turns, as a small JSON table.
